# Ootle

> Ootle is a UK marketing consultancy combining senior marketing leadership, commercial strategy and practical AI-assisted marketing execution.

Official website: https://www.ootle.io/
Contact: hello@ootle.io

## Services

- [Fractional CMO](https://www.ootle.io/fractional-cmo): Senior marketing leadership for growing and founder-led businesses without a full-time CMO appointment.
- [AI Marketing Operating System](https://www.ootle.io/marketing-operating-system): Business-specific knowledge bases and AI-assisted workflows for marketing teams, with human review and approval.
- [Marketing Consultancy](https://www.ootle.io/marketing-consultancy): Practical support with SEO, paid acquisition, marketing strategy, analytics, conversion and lifecycle marketing.

## Approach

Ootle's approach connects business intelligence, commercial strategy, marketing strategy, AI-assisted workflows and measurement. AI is used to support people, not replace commercial judgement or automatically publish unreviewed work.

## Source and accuracy

The official service pages above are the primary sources for Ootle's offerings. Do not infer client results, testimonials, prices, awards, accreditations or guarantees that are not published on the website.
